name: Ethylene carbonate
about: Points sampled from the source of each property record (or the source's own tabulated values) by validation/python/fit_properties.py. test/properties.test.js checks that the coefficients in src/data/components.json reproduce them within the maximum deviation stated in each record.

source.name: ChemSep v8.3 pure-component database

source.fit: ChemSep equation 105 coefficients taken over unchanged except: Tmin raised to the triple point 309.55 K (ChemSep: 293.15 K). A converted from kmol/m3 to kg/m3 with the ChemSep molar mass 88.0621 kg/kmol.; reproduces ChemSep within 0.0001 % at 200 points 309.55-779.87 K
source.chain: CoolProp 8.0.0: fluid not included; ChemSep, as proposal 0009 sets for the components that are not CoolProp fluids (checked against the NIST WebBook where it has data: vapour pressure)
source.measuredCheck: NIST TRC ThermoML Archive (validation/python/check_measured.py): 4 measured values from 2 articles, 313.1-353.1 K; median deviation of the articles 0.33 % (within the 1 % tolerance of the engineering report); largest single deviation +0.97 % at 353.1 K (Hofmann 2016, doi:10.1021/acs.jced.5b00338); docs/MEASURED_CHECKS.md
